notes: Instantiated the two new workspaces (StarLabs, BetaCorp) with their new users, memberships, and channels exactly as specified in the design's roles. The focal selector follows the assigned route (channels->teams->user_teams->users) with all conditions (role='admin', real_name contains 'Robert') conjoined in one query on the same user_teams row, correctly returning the union of T01WORKSPACE's 11 non-DM channels and StarLabs's 2 channels (13 total), while excluding the private DM (is_dm scope filter) and excluding BetaCorp (its admin, Sam Cole, does not match 'Robert'). Robert Diaz's membership row in T01 is role='member', so it does not add or remove anything beyond Robert Walsh's admin row there; his BetaCorp channel-membership (not workspace-membership) is captured only as a negative supporting fact, not as a route match. To resolve the prior access-unresolved failure without relying on unsupported team_id-based workspace switching, the actor (U01AGENBOT9) was given real workspace memberships in all three teams and channel memberships in all three new channels (starlabs-general, starlabs-engineering, betacorp-general), so users.conversations can discover them via documented membership-based listing, and conversations.history/members can confirm their contents and exclude BetaCorp on ordinary-language grounds. users.info-exposed profiles remain deterministic since every new user (Robert Kim, Robert Diaz, Sam Cole) holds exactly one workspace membership.
